I am a young woman with a small piece of land, only a quarter hectare, and I must feed my family from it. I watch what my neighbors do — some got the coupon from the government for fertilizer, and last season I managed to get one bag of NPK and a little urea through the subsidy, so I will try again this year. I cannot afford the hybrid seed every year, but I kept some seed from last harvest and I will plant that together with pigeon pea between the maize rows like my mother taught me. I have no money for pesticide, and the river is far, so I wait for the rains like everyone here.
